LunchBot: Patio reservation confirmed for 6:00–7:30. Reminder will post at 5:45.

Priya: I'll Venmo $5 to Lina now. @Lina what's your handle?
Lina: lina-pay (or cash works). :cashbag: 
Becca: Any nut allergies we should know about? @Dan?
Dan: No allergies here.
Priya: Also FYI some teams still on late calls — let's keep music low volume and avoid drums. :speaker: 
Becca: I'll queue up an acoustic playlist. 
Omar: Rain plan: conference room B (I have the key).
Lina: Awesome. Thanks everyone! See you at 6. If anyone else wants to join last-minute, drop a 👍 here. 
(reacts: Lina +1 :thumbsup:, Omar adds :ice_cream:)
